site.description: Your data in one place, and your AI assistant working with it over MCP.

tag.title: Your tag
tag.hint: Show it to whoever adds you to their space.
tag.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the tag and copy it by hand.
tag.dialogBody: The old tag stops working. Invitations already sent are unaffected.
tag.tooSoon: The tag was just changed, give it a minute.
tag.notAllowed: The tag can only be changed in the Unitcore app.
tag.unknown: Could not change the tag. Try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.recentDescription: The latest entries across your spaces.

empty.title: Nothing to total up yet
empty.description: Once transactions land in one of your spaces, this page totals them up by month and by currency.

blog.title: Articles
blog.subtitle: Guides and notes about connecting an AI assistant to your own data.
blog.notFoundBody: This article either does not exist or is not available in this language yet.

login.title: Login
login.description: Enter your email below to login to your account

signUpSuccess.title: Thank you for signing up!
signUpSuccess.body: You've successfully signed up. Please check your email to confirm your account before signing in.

forgotPassword.title: Reset Your Password
forgotPassword.description: Type in your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password
forgotPassword.successBody: If you registered using your email and password, you will receive a password reset email.

updatePassword.title: Reset Your Password
updatePassword.description: Please enter your new password below

access.title: What this client may do
access.readWriteHint: Add and edit transactions, categories and spaces.
access.readOnlyHint: Look at your budget without changing anything.

connections.title: Connected applications
connections.subtitle: Every application you have connected, and what each one may do with your budget.
connections.writeHint: This client can add and edit transactions, categories and spaces.
connections.noGrant: Permissions not set. This client can only read.
connections.revokeHint: The refresh token dies at once; an access token already issued keeps working for up to an hour.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.subtitle: Your personal space, and every space you share with someone.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.warning: You will see every transaction in this space and be able to change them. Everything you add, the other members see.

errors.notFound: This invitation is no longer valid.
errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask to be invited again.
errors.spaceFull: This space already has as many members as it can hold.
errors.emailUnconfirmed: Confirm your email address first — we sent the letter when you signed up.
errors.notAllowed: Invitations can only be answered in the Unitcore app.
errors.unknown: That did not work. Try again.

detail.notFound: This space does not exist, or you are no longer a member of it.

members.title: Members
members.notAMember: This person is no longer a member of this space.

invite.label: Member tag
invite.hint: Ask the person to copy the tag from their profile.
invite.confirmBody: {name} gets an invitation and can accept or decline it.
invite.notFound: No such tag. Check that it was copied correctly.
invite.already: This person is already a member.
invite.spaceFull: This space already has as many members as it can hold.
invite.tooManyPending: Too many unanswered invitations. Wait for an answer or take one back.
invite.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.

pending.title: Waiting for an answer
pending.gone: This invitation is no longer waiting for an answer.

leave.title: Leave this space
leave.hint: You lose access to everything in it. Nothing is deleted, and the owner can invite you again.
leave.dialogBody: Its transactions and categories disappear from your budget. Nothing is deleted, and the owner can invite you again.
leave.notAMember: You are no longer a member of this space.

remove.title: Delete this space
remove.hint: Everything in it goes too: transactions, their items, categories and the list of members. This cannot be undone.
remove.dialogBody: Transactions, items, categories and members are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
remove.confirmLabel: Type the name of the space to confirm:

errors.notAllowed: Not allowed: only the owner can change a space, and the personal space can never be deleted.
errors.silent: Nothing changed: this space is not yours any more, or it is already gone.
errors.unknown: That did not work. Try again.
